q: By March 31, 2027, the IAEA announces that it has verified on site the location and quantity of Iran's stockpile of 60 percent enriched uranium
basis: Since the war began, Iran has denied IAEA inspectors access to its facilities and says part of the stockpile is buried in rubble from the airstrikes. Even if a U.S.-Iran phased agreement is signed by the end of March, verifying the stockpile is likely to come at a later stage. This forecast tests whether Washington's top-ranked course, phased negotiations with nuclear conditions, can be carried out.
rs: Reports and statements by the IAEA director general
